subject: Kickoff: BrightBridge vendor setup + PO format/timing
messages:
From: sergio_alvarez@redwoodai.com
To: sara.byrne@brightbridge.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, dev_patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: BrightBridge vendor setup + PO format/timing

Hi Sara —

Welcome! Glad to kick off vendor onboarding for BrightBridge. To get the procurement side squared away quickly I wanted to confirm a few PO and vendor-setup items so we can avoid back-and-forth after the first invoice:

1) Required vendor paperwork: do you have a current W-9 and company bank details we can upload? If there are any hire/engagement-specific forms BrightBridge requires from Redwood, please flag them.

2) PO policy: Our standard practice is to issue a Purchase Order that references a single master line (service subscription) plus optional per-feature line-items for professional services or overage tiers. If BrightBridge requires per-feature line-items up front, let us know the preferred description format and unit quantities.

3) Timeline: Procurement at Redwood needs ~5 business days to validate vendor docs and issue the first PO after we have signed SOW/contract and completed the vendor profile. If you need expedited PO issuance (<=48 hours) we can request an exception from finance — what timeline do you need?

I attached an onboarding checklist (RBW_vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) and our PO template (RBW_PO_template_v2.xlsx) to show the typical line-item layout.

Next steps from our side: I’ll loop in Dev (procurement owner) and Laura (sales ops) to confirm internal approvals. If you can return the W-9 and a contact for billing/AR that will speed things up.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this set up.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodai.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: RBW_vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), RBW_PO_template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: sara.byrne@brightbridge.com

Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BrightBridge vendor setup + PO format/timing

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the quick note. I can confirm we have an updated W-9 and bank remit details; attaching them shortly from our contracts mailbox (contracts@brightbridge.com will also receive these). A few clarifying points from our side: 

- For billing we prefer separate line-items for: subscription (monthly), implementation (one-time), and training (one-time, hourly rate). Each should include a quantity and unit price.
- We require PO numbers on invoices and a 30 day NET payment term.
- For expedited onboarding we could accept a preliminary PO (placeholder values) within 48 hrs if full vendor profile is pending, and then receive a final PO once vendor verification completes.

Can you confirm whether Redwood uses a single line-item code/sku for cloud inference consumption or whether you prefer itemized consumption lines per model/feature? That will help us set up our AP mapping.

Sara Byrne
Head of Procurement Operations
BrightBridge Analytics
sara.byrne@brightbridge.com

From: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff: BrightBridge vendor setup + PO format/timing

Sergio / Dev —

Looping in procurement (Dev) explicitly to take ownership of verification and PO issuance. Quick internal guidance for this account: 

- PO structure: finance prefers a master subscription line (SKU: RB-INF-SUB) with recurring quantity = number of seats/month or TB-hours, plus discrete lines for implementation/services (SKU: RB-INF-PS) and training (SKU: RB-INF-TR). When external requires separate line-items for accounting, we mirror their requested labels in the description field and keep the SKU mapping on our side for reporting.

- Required vendor docs: W-9 + vendor banking + corporate registration are mandatory. We'll need to upload BrightBridge_W9.pdf to Coupa/Vendor Portal and validate bank remit via micro-deposit or bank letter (contracts@brightbridge.com should provide).

- Timeline & expediting: Standard processing -> 5 business days after docs and signed SOW. For a 48 hr preliminary PO we need sales to sign off on an exception reason (e.g., go-live dependency). Sergio, please confirm customer asks for preliminary PO in writing (they did), and I will open an expedited approval request with Finance.

- Line-item details: For consumption billing (inference usage), if they want per-model breakdown we ask for mapping to an existing metric; otherwise we bill via a single usage SKU with monthly quantity. Provide an example estimate so procurement can lock the quantity mapping.

Dev — please start vendor profile creation and set Coupa vendor status to "Pending Validation". Attach the RBW_PO_template_v2.xlsx I shared in the thread and flag any missing fields to me.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodai.com

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and for coordinating with contracts. Summary and concrete asks so procurement can move forward without ambiguity: 

1) PO line-item plan (we will mirror your preference):
   - Subscription (SKU: RB-INF-SUB): monthly recurring, description: "Redwood Inference - Hosted API subscription (BrightBridge)"; quantity: estimated 1 unit = account-level subscription; if you prefer TB-hour or seat-based quantity, provide mapping and we will set the quantity accordingly.
   - Implementation (SKU: RB-INF-PS): one-time, description: "Implementation services - onboarding & integration"; please provide expected hours if you want units.
   - Training (SKU: RB-INF-TR): one-time, description: "Training sessions (per hour)"; indicate number of hours or leave as TBD and bill against final PO.

2) Invoice & term confirmation: Redwood invoices will include PO number; we can accept NET30. Finance needs the invoice remit-to info you will include on the W-9/bank remit.

3) Expedite request: Laura has agreed to request a 48 hr preliminary PO. Please confirm via reply to this thread that BrightBridge accepts a preliminary PO for onboarding with final PO to follow after vendor validation. Once you confirm, Dev will create the vendor profile and I will request the expedite.

I attached a filled example of RBW_PO_template_v2.xlsx with placeholder values so you can see the expected format (line-item descriptions and SKU mapping).

Thanks — I’ll await your confirmation on the preliminary PO and any per-line quantity estimates.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodai.com
